义项: 形容词 问题、状况尚可纠正或改善（not easily remediable 不易补救）
[构词] remedy v. 补救 → remediable；反义 irremediable 无可挽回的

例句.英文: Although this approach can yield many insights about the biological past, it remains a relatively underutilized resource in part because hDNA is often to some extent degraded, a situation not easily remediable under current methodological paradigms and with extant DNA extraction and analysis technologies.
例句.中文: 尽管这一路径有独特优势，例如可以获取已灭绝种群的基因组数据，它仍是一种相对未被充分利用的资源：历史 DNA 往往有不同程度的降解，而在现有的方法论范式与 DNA 提取分析技术下，这一状况不易补救。

例句.英文: Although this approach offers unique benefits, such as the ability to contrast historical genomic data with present-day data, it remains relatively underutilized because archival specimens are sometimes stored in ways that compromise DNA quality, a situation not easily remediable under current methodological paradigms and with extant DNA extraction and analysis technologies.
例句.中文: 尽管这种方法有独特优势（如把历史基因组数据与当下数据作对比），它仍未被充分利用：档案标本的保存方式有时会损害 DNA 质量，在现行方法论范式与现存 DNA 提取、分析技术下都不易补救。

义项: 形容词 由主观意愿驱动的、有意为之的（volitional laughter 有意发出的笑）
[辨析] 与 spontaneous（自发的、不由自主的）构成反义对照，实验设计常用这一对概念

例句.英文: Study participants from 21 societies, including those in Japan and Turkey, listened to randomized recordings of 18 spontaneous laughs taken from natural conversations between pairs of women and 18 volitional laughs produced separately by 18 different women in response to an instruction to laugh.
例句.中文: 来自 21 个社会（包括奥地利与萨摩亚）的研究参与者，听了一批随机排序的录音：18 段取自两名女性自然对话中的自发笑声，以及另外 18 名女性按指令发出的有意笑声。

例句.英文: Psychologists Gregory Bryant, Dorsa Amir, and colleagues investigated cross-cultural perceptions of spontaneous (real) laughter and volitional (fake or forced) laughter.
例句.中文: 心理学家 Gregory Bryant、Dorsa Amir 及同事研究了不同文化对自发（真实）笑声与自主（伪装或勉强）笑声的感知。

义项: 名词 某一词根的成分在同一词族另一词内部重复（可带音变），如 teeny-weeny
[构词] re- 再 + duplicate 复制 → reduplicate → reduplication；语言学专门术语

例句.英文: This phenomenon, in which an element of a root word is repeated, sometimes with modification, within another word that is related to the root word, is called reduplication.
例句.中文: 某一词根的成分在与之相关的另一个词内部重复（有时带变化），这一现象称为重叠构词。

例句.英文: There are many examples of this type of reduplication in Hoocak.
例句.中文: 霍乔克语中有许多这类重叠构词的例子。

义项: 动词 把某物从其它事物中划分出来（demarcate A as B 把 A 划归为 B）
[构词] de- 加强 + mark 标记 → demarcate；名词 demarcation 分界

例句.英文: Noting that some stories feature detailed descriptions of geographic locations in the Cherokee homeland, Mooney demarcated those as a genre he referred to as “wonder stories.” While Long and Mooney’s collaboration proved valuable as an act of cultural preservation, it is important to bear in mind that Cherokee people are not known to have applied genre divisions to their stories before Mooney’s work.
例句.中文: Mooney 注意到有些故事对切罗基故土的地理位置有细致描写，便把这类故事划为一个他称为「奇谭」的类别。

义项: 动词 使缠结在一起（entangled tubes 缠绕的管子）
动词 (引申义) be entangled in 卷入（纠纷、关系）；名词 entanglement 纠缠

例句.英文: Her sculpture Ocupante is made of entangled blue and white LED tubes.
例句.原书高亮: entangled blue and white LED tubes
例句.中文: 她的雕塑《Ocupante》由蓝白两色 LED 灯管缠绕而成。

义项: 形容词 与快感、愉悦本身相关的（hedonic motivation 享乐动机）
[辨析] 消费行为学里与 utilitarian（实用性的）相对：一个买「爽」，一个买「用」

例句.英文: They hypothesized that hedonic motivation (the enjoyment that a consumer perceives to be associated with using a service) would be positively correlated with users’ intentions to adopt premium versions.
例句.中文: 他们假设，享乐动机（消费者认为使用某项服务所带来的愉悦）会与用户采用付费版本的意愿正相关。

例句.英文: However, Lee and Hosanagar also determined that whereas an RS had a stronger positive effect on item views for utilitarian products (e.g., toothbrushes) than for hedonic products (e.g., chocolates), the RS had a stronger positive effect on likelihood of purchase for hedonic products than for utilitarian ones.
例句.中文: 然而 Lee 与 Hosanagar 还发现：评分对实用型产品（如牙刷）浏览量的提升强于享乐型产品（如巧克力），但对享乐型产品购买可能性的提升反而更强。

义项: 名词 失去水分的过程（episodic desiccation 周期性干涸）
[构词] de- 去除 + sicc（拉丁 siccus 干）→ desiccate → desiccation；地质学常用

例句.英文: To characterize the nature of the depositional environment, Frances Rivera-Hernández et al. analyzed the grain size of Murray Formation sediment, finding that although there are intervals of coarse grains, most of the sediment consists of fine grains that show signs of cracking due to episodic desiccation.
例句.中文: 大部分沉积物由细颗粒组成，这些颗粒显示出因周期性干燥而开裂的迹象。

义项: 动词 使某人感到满足、高兴（find it gratifying that… 对…感到欣慰）
[辨析] 比 satisfy 更偏情感上的满足；gratifying 常作形容词「令人欣慰的」

例句.英文: Still, he knows that each component of a building, however small, is nevertheless essential, and he finds it gratifying that after all his years of schooling, all his crits [reviews] and unbuilt projects, his efforts are to have some practical end.
例句.中文: 不过他知道，建筑的每一个构件无论多小都不可或缺；让他欣慰的是，求学多年、经历过那么多评图与未能建成的方案之后，自己的努力总算有了实际用处。

义项: 形容词 过分显眼、惹人注意的（less obtrusive 不那么扎眼）
[构词] ob- 朝向 + trude 推 → obtrude 强加 → obtrusive；反义 unobtrusive 不露痕迹的

例句.英文: The changes of the seasons are less obtrusive on spots of this kind than amid woodland scenery.
例句.中文: 在这类地方，季节的更替不如在林地里那样惹眼。

义项: 形容词 以书信形式写成的（epistolary novel 书信体小说）
[构词] epistle 书信 → epistolary；SAT 文学体裁题高频标签

例句.英文: The Incarnations (2015) is an epistolary novel by English author Susan Barker.
例句.中文: 《The Incarnations》（2015）是英国作家 Susan Barker 的一部书信体小说。

例句.英文: Epistolary novels are novels written primarily as a series of fictional documents.
例句.中文: 书信体小说主要以一系列虚构书信文件的形式写成的小说。

义项: 动词 使变窄、收紧（constricted pupils 缩小的瞳孔）
动词 (引申义) 限制、压抑（constrict freedom）；名词 constriction

例句.英文: Studies have found that when looking at other people’s eyes, humans tend to perceive dilated pupils positively and constricted pupils negatively.
例句.中文: 研究发现，人在注视他人眼睛时，倾向于对放大的瞳孔作正面评价，对缩小的瞳孔作负面评价。

义项: 形容词 仿制的、以次充好的替代品（ersatz coffee 代用咖啡）
形容词 哲学「仿制现在论」ersatz presentism：以抽象替代物充当过去

例句.英文: Ersatz presentism posits that the statement is made true by an abstract (“ersatz”) time that exists outside temporal time and represents how things were in the past.
例句.中文: 「仿制现在论」主张：该陈述之所以为真，是因为存在一个处于时间之外、代表过去事物状态的抽象「仿制」时间。

例句.英文: Lucretianism posits that the statement is made true by the world’s acceptance of the past-tensed property of “having contained dinosaurs.”. 2006: Presentist philosopher Craig Bourne proposed “ersatz presentism.”.
例句.中文: 卢克莱修主义主张：该陈述之为真，在于世界接受了「曾经包含恐龙」这一过去时态属性。——2006 年，现在论哲学家 Craig Bourne 提出「代用品现在论」。

义项: 名词 研究程序可被追查、复现的程度（level of traceability）
[构词] trace 追踪 → traceable → traceability；科研可复现性讨论的核心指标

例句.英文: The team gave each of these studies a rating for level of traceability (with a higher rating for clearer description of procedures) and for category consistency (with a higher rating for using materials categories more closely aligned with the categories in the team's database).
例句.中文: 团队为每项研究评定了可追溯性等级（程序描述越清晰得分越高）与类别一致性等级（所用材料类别越接近团队数据库的分类，得分越高）。

义项: 形容词 细微到感官无法辨别的（imperceptible features 肉眼难见的细节）
[构词] im- 否定 + perceptible 可感知的；反义 perceptible 明显的

例句.英文: Because they penetrate the visible surface of a painting, ultraviolet and other nonvisible spectra of light enable the detection of otherwise imperceptible features of the work.
例句.中文: 由于紫外线及其他不可见光谱能穿透画面的表层，它们使画作中那些原本难以察觉的特征得以被发现。

义项: 动词 严厉批评、责骂（chastise the audience 数落观众）
[辨析] 与 castigate 近义，语气正式；此处指现场表演者与观众互动时调侃责备

例句.英文: Wade cites features of the texts indicative of live performance, such as chastising the audience, extensive use of simple structures (allowing for easy memorization), and requests for tips (payment) from listeners.
例句.中文: Wade 举出文本中表明现场表演的特征，例如数落观众、大量使用易于记诵的简单结构，以及向听众索要赏钱。

义项: 形容词 cuneus 楔 + form 形状；指笔画呈楔状的古代文字
名词 楔形文字（cuneiform script），美索不达米亚最早的文字系统

例句.英文: The cuneiform script is the earliest known set of symbols used for writing.
例句.中文: 楔形文字是目前已知最早的一套用于书写的符号系统。

例句.英文: Sumerian was one of the first languages to be written using the cuneiform script.
例句.中文: 苏美尔语是最早用楔形文字书写的语言之一。

义项: 名词 员工经常不到岗的情况（reduce absenteeism 降低缺勤率）
[辨析] 与 presenteeism（带病出勤、人在心不在）成对出现，是职场健康研究的两个指标

例句.英文: Michelle Pereira et al. hypothesized that introducing health improvements into workplaces would increase productivity by reducing absenteeism (sick employees not working) and presenteeism (sick workers working less productively due to illness).
例句.中文: Michelle Pereira 等人假设，在工作场所推行健康改善措施可以提高生产率，途径是减少缺勤（生病员工不来上班）与「带病出勤」（生病员工上班但效率降低）。

义项: 动词 数量逐渐减少到所剩无几（dwindling population 不断萎缩的种群）
[辨析] 强调持续、不可逆的减少；比 decrease 更有「日渐枯竭」的意味

例句.英文: In response to a rapidly dwindling population of blueback salmon, the Quinault Indian Nation (a tribe in Washington State) partnered with the conservation organization Wild Salmon Center to restore naturally occurring logjams in the Quinault River.
例句.中文: 面对蓝背鲑数量的急剧下降，奎诺尔特印第安部落（华盛顿州的一个部落）与保护组织「野鲑中心」合作，在奎诺尔特河恢复天然形成的木桩阻塞。

义项: 形容词 不愿多谈、有所保留的（reticent about sth 对某事避而不谈）
[辨析] 不是「害羞」，而是「刻意不说」；名词 reticence 沉默寡言

例句.英文: The narrator has asked the woman he rents a room from about Ethan Frome, a town resident he encountered recently.Her mind was a store-house of innocuous anecdote and any question about her acquaintances brought forth a volume of detail; but on the subject of Ethan Frome I found her unexpectedly reticent.
例句.中文: 但一谈到《Ethan Frome》，我发现她出乎意料地不愿多言。

义项: 动词 分散的元素聚合成一个整体（coalesce into 汇合成）
[构词] co- 共同 + alescere 生长；名词 coalescence 合并

例句.英文: Magical realism, a style that weaves fantasy into realistic narratives, coalesced in Latin America in the 1960s.
例句.中文: 魔幻现实主义——一种把幻想编织进现实叙事的风格——于 1960 年代在拉丁美洲成形。

例句.英文: One popular theory of the origin of the Moon, the "big whack," posits that a protoplanet called Theia collided with Earth, flinging debris into orbit that eventually coalesced into the Moon.
例句.中文: 一种流行的月球起源理论——「大碰撞说」——认为：一颗名为忒伊亚的原行星撞上地球，抛出的碎片进入轨道，最终聚合成月球。

义项: 动词 做事超出本分或能力所及（overreach oneself 弄巧成拙）
动词 overreaching for status：为攀比地位而越界，社会史语境指僭越等级

例句.英文: Such laws, enacted against a backdrop of anxiety about social dynamism, were intended to limit aspirational overreaching for status but were infrequently enforced.
例句.中文: 这类法律在人们对社会阶层流动感到焦虑的背景下颁布，本意是限制为攫取地位而进行的攀比越界，却很少真正执行。

义项: 形容词 与常识判断相反的（seem counterintuitive 看似不合常理）
[构词] counter- 反 + intuitive 直觉的；SAT 科学类文章的高频评价词

例句.英文: Evidence now shows that being prompted to consider the shared biology of all humans can cause individuals to identify more strongly with humanity overall, suggesting that emphasis on the “human family tree” may promote collective action. Text 2Perhaps counterintuitively, a focus on group distinctions can help ensure that responsibility for issues with global effects (e.g., freshwater shortages and biodiversity loss) is shared globally.
例句.中文: 现有证据表明，引导人们思考全人类共同的生物属性，能使个体更强烈地认同全人类——这提示，强调「人类家树」或可促成集体行动。——或许有悖直觉，聚焦群体差异反而有助于确保：对具有全球性影响的问题（如淡水短缺、生物多样性丧失），责任由全球共同分担。

义项: 名词 河道中呈 U 形的弯道（地理学专门义）
动词 (引申义) 蜿蜒而行；（谈话、思路）漫无边际地展开

例句.英文: U-shaped curve in a river channel is called a meander.
例句.中文: 河道中呈 U 形的弯曲称为河曲。

例句.英文: A river with high sinuosity has many meanders, and a river with low sinuosity has few. .
例句.中文: 弯曲度高的河流有许多河曲，弯曲度低的河流则很少。

义项: 形容词 把复杂事物削足适履地归约为单一因素（how reductive this model is）
[构词] reduce 缩减 → reductive；reductionism 还原论，学术批评常用贬义

例句.英文: Alemu Mekonnen and Gunnar Kohlin's study of fuel use in Ethiopia shows how reductive this model is, however: although income of course constrained fuel choice, several circumstances, including the local availability of different fuel sources, influenced decisions.
例句.中文: 然而，Alemu Mekonnen 与 Gunnar Kohlin 对埃塞俄比亚燃料使用的研究显示，这一模型何等简化：收入固然制约了燃料选择，但包括当地各类燃料可获得性在内的多种情况都影响了决策。

例句.英文: Rasmus Heltberg’s study of fuel use in Ghana shows this model to be reductive, however: household fuel use was heterogeneous, flexible, and influenced by several factors, including the stability of the local electrical grid.
例句.中文: 然而 Rasmus Heltberg 对加纳燃料使用的研究表明该模型过于简化：家庭燃料使用是异质而灵活的，受当地电网稳定性等多种因素影响。

义项: 动词 把某事的原因归于某人或某物（ascribe A to B）
[辨析] 与 attribute 近义；ascribe 更常用于「把…说成是…造成的」这一解释性语境

例句.英文: The linguistic niche hypothesis (LNH) posits that the exotericity of languages (how prevalent non-native speakers are) and grammatical complexity are inversely related, which the LNH ascribes to attrition of complex grammatical rules as more non-native speakers adopt the language but fail to acquire those rules.
例句.中文: 语言生态位假说认为，语言的「外族性」（非母语使用者的普遍程度）与语法复杂度呈反比；该假说把这归因于：随着越来越多非母语者习得该语言却未能掌握这些规则，复杂的语法规则逐渐磨蚀。

义项: 名词 为达到目的而使用的诡计（full of guile 满是心机）
[辨析] 文学语域，与 cunning 近义；形容词 guileless 反义「不设防的」

例句.英文: Aunt Polly asked [Tom] questions that were full of guile, and very deep—for she wanted to trap him into damaging revealments.
例句.中文: 波莉姨妈问汤姆的问题满是圈套，而且用意极深——她想诱他露出破绽。

义项: 形容词 梦幻、非理性并置的超现实主义风格（surrealist collage 超现实拼贴）
[构词] sur- 超 + real 现实 → surreal → surrealism → surrealist

例句.英文: Felipe Posada (pseudonym The Invisible Realm) is a New York City-based artist who specializes in the form of art known as surrealist collage.
例句.中文: Felipe Posada（化名 The Invisible Realm）是一位常驻纽约的艺术家，专攻超现实主义拼贴。

义项: 名词 相对于神职人员的普通信众（the laity 俗人群体）
[辨析] 与 clergy（神职人员）成对；形容词 lay 世俗的、非专业的

例句.英文: Ely is a clergyman in the town of Milby. By the laity of Milby and its neighbourhood [Mr.
例句.中文: Ely 是米尔比镇的一位牧师；在米尔比及其周边的平信徒看来，他是……

义项: 形容词 意在平息怒气、寻求和解的（conciliatory response 安抚性回应）
[构词] conciliate 安抚 → conciliatory；与 confrontational 相对

例句.英文: Conciliatory responses were most effective at mitigating the impact of concrete reviews, whereas more defensive responses were more useful when reviews were relatively abstract.
例句.中文: 安抚性回应在减轻具体评价所带来的冲击方面最为有效。

义项: 名词 杠杆绕其转动的固定点（物理学专门义）
名词 (引申义) 比喻「关键支撑点、着力点」

例句.英文: A lever is a simple machine consisting of a rigid beam and a fulcrum.
例句.原书高亮: a rigid beam and a fulcrum
例句.中文: 杠杆是一种简单机械，由一根刚性横梁和一个支点构成。

例句.英文: In first-class levers, the fulcrum is located between the effort and the load..
例句.中文: 在第一类杠杆中，支点位于作用力与负荷之间。

义项: 动词 两端分别落在不同范畴、时期或立场上（straddle the line between 介于两者之间）
动词 跨坐、叉腿而立

例句.英文: The late-period pieces of James Tate arguably fit this description, since they straddle the line between prose and poetry.
例句.原书高亮: straddle the line between prose and poetry
例句.中文: James Tate 晚期的作品大概符合这一描述，因为它们横跨在散文与诗歌的分界线上。

例句.英文: Her art, too, straddles multiple boundaries.
例句.中文: 她的艺术同样跨越多重边界。

义项: 名词 在同类中显得反常、格格不入的事物（an oddity within her body of work）
[构词] odd 奇怪的 → oddity；与 anomaly 近义

例句.英文: Virginia Woolf’s 1928 novel Orlando is an oddity within her body of work.
例句.原书高亮: an oddity within her body of work
例句.中文: 弗吉尼亚·伍尔夫 1928 年的小说《Orlando》是她全部作品中一个异类。

义项: 形容词 依凭自由联想而非逻辑线性展开的（associative logic 联想逻辑）
[构词] associate 关联 → associative；与 linear（线性的）对照

例句.英文: In a study of the mechanisms underlying associative memory—or the ability to learn and remember connections between inherently unrelated things—neuroscientists Kei Igarashi, Jasmine Chavez, and others presented mice with memory tests.
例句.中文: 在一项关于联想记忆机制（即学习并记住本无关联事物之间联系的能力）的研究中，神经科学家 Kei Igarashi、Jasmine Chavez 等人对小鼠进行了记忆测试。

例句.英文: The team discovered that fan cells, a type of cell found in the medial temporal lobe of the brain, are necessary for the acquisition of new associative memories.
例句.中文: 研究团队发现：扇形细胞——大脑内侧颞叶中的一类细胞——是获得新联想记忆的必要条件。

义项: 形容词 说话坦率、不绕弯子的（a narrative voice so forthright）
[辨析] 褒义偏多，含「坦诚得近乎不加修饰」；与 blunt 相比少一分粗鲁

例句.英文: Autofiction usually borrows formal elements from autobiographical writing too, including its first person point of view and its use of a narrative voice so forthright that it borders on confessional.
例句.原书高亮: so forthright that it borders on confessional
例句.中文: 自传体小说通常也借用自传写作的形式要素，包括第一人称视角，以及一种直率到近乎自白的叙事声音。

义项: 形容词 由人类活动造成的（anthropogenic noise 人为噪声）
[构词] anthropo- 人类 + -genic 产生；气候、生态语境的核心术语

例句.英文: In a meta-analysis of more than 100 studies of anthropogenic noise and various species and classes of animals, Kunc and Schmidt found that, on average, mammals showed larger effects from the noise than birds did.
例句.中文: Kunc 与 Schmidt 对 100 多项关于人为噪声与各类动物的研究做了元分析，发现平均而言哺乳动物受到的影响大于鸟类。

例句.英文: The researchers ultimately recommended that reducing anthropogenic emissions remain the primary focus of urban air-quality improvement efforts.
例句.中文: 研究者最终建议：改善城市空气质量仍应以削减人为排放为首要目标。

义项: 动词 把原本非商品的事物转化为可售卖、可获利的形式（monetized sale 以货币出售）
[构词] money → monetize；名词 monetization 货币化

例句.英文: Crislayne Alfagali and other Africanist scholars have shown, however, that in parts of Africa, wage labor competition, the manufacture of surplus goods for monetized sale, and other features of capitalism predated colonization.
例句.中文: 为以货币出售而生产过剩商品。

义项: 名词 为某项事业投入的资金（outlays for lobbying 游说开支）
[辨析] 比 expense 更强调「一次性投入的款项」；动词短语 outlay on sth

例句.英文: Private foundations are prohibited from holding excess interests in a business enterprise, “self-dealing” (conducting activities that benefit foundation insiders), making taxable expenditures such as outlays for lobbying, and failing to cross a required threshold in making charitable distributions from income.
例句.中文: 私人基金会不得在企业中持有超额权益、不得进行「自我交易」（从事使基金会内部人获益的活动）、不得进行应税支出（如游说开支），也不得在从收入中划拨慈善捐赠时未达到规定比例。

义项: 形容词 性情温和、待人友善的（your amiable ward 您那位可亲的被监护人）
[辨析] 与 amicable（关系和睦的）区分：amiable 形容人，amicable 形容关系或协议

例句.英文: Mirvan’s family.It is very earnestly [the Mirvans’] wish to enlarge and enliven their party by the addition of your amiable ward, who would share, equally with her own daughter, the care and attention of Mrs.
例句.中文: Mirvan 一家非常恳切地希望，把您那位和蔼可亲的被监护人加入他们的聚会，使宾主更为热闹。

义项: 名词 城墙、堡垒等加固设施（the fortifications and impediments）
名词 (引申义) 强化、加固（fortification of food 营养强化）

例句.英文: I had gazed upon the fortifications and impediments that seemed to keep human beings from entering the citadel of nature, and rashly and ignorantly I had repined.
例句.中文: 我曾凝望那些仿佛阻止人类进入自然之城堡的防御工事与障碍，并且轻率而无知地心生怨怼。

义项: 名词 外观或品格上的小缺点（slight blemishes 微小的瑕疵）
动词 (引申义) 损害、玷污（blemish one's reputation）

例句.英文: It is true, the Countess was a little vain, a little ambitious, a little selfish, a little shallow and frivolous, a little given to white lies,—But who considers such slight blemishes, such moral pimples as these, disqualifications for entering into the most respectable society!
例句.中文: 不错，伯爵夫人是有点虚荣、有点野心、有点自私、有点浅薄轻浮，也有点爱说些无伤大雅的小谎——可谁会把这样轻微的瑕疵、这样道德上的小痘痘，当作不能进入最体面社交圈的理由呢！

义项: 名词 物体被拧转时产生的形变（力学专门义）
[构词] tort- 扭曲 → torsion；形容词 torsional 扭转的

例句.英文: The twisting of an object is known as torsion.
例句.中文: 物体被拧转，这一形变称为扭转。

例句.英文: A 2019 study led by researchers Zunfeng Liu and Ray Baughman tested the torsional heating and cooling of various fibers.
例句.中文: 2019 年由 Zunfeng Liu 与 Ray Baughman 领导的研究测试了多种纤维的扭转加热与冷却效应。

义项: 形容词 依类别整体处理的（categorical exclusion 类别豁免）
形容词 (引申义) 绝对的、无条件的（a categorical denial 断然否认）

例句.英文: While many NEPA reviews require public comment, categorical exclusions (CEs) allow quick reviews with no public comment for actions that will minimally affect the environment.
例句.中文: 许多《国家环境政策法》的审查需要公众评议，但「类别豁免」允许对环境影响极小的行为快速审查、无需公众评议。

义项: 副词 依照年代先后排列（chronologically expansive 时间跨度大的）
[构词] chrono- 时间 + logy 学科 → chronological → chronologically

例句.英文: Shurin’s volume is chronologically expansive, featuring such stories as James Tiptree Jr.’s “The Girl Who Was Plugged In” (1973) and Lavanya Lakshminarayan’s “Études” (2020).
例句.中文: Shurin 编选的这卷书在时间上跨度很大，收录了 James Tiptree Jr. 的《The Girl Who Was Plugged In》（1973）与 Lavanya Lakshminarayan 的《Études》（2020）等作品。

义项: 动词 使（坏情况）变得更糟（crises exacerbated by… 因…而加剧的危机）
[辨析] 只用于负面事物；不能与 improve 互换，SAT 常考搭配误用

例句.英文: In response to concerns that some recent financial crises were exacerbated by consumers misunderstanding risks associated with credit cards, loans, and other financial products, policymakers in many countries have instituted risk-disclosure requirements on sellers of those products.
例句.中文: 由于担心近来的金融危机部分源于消费者误解了信用卡、贷款等金融产品的相关风险，许多国家的监管者对这些产品的销售方设立了风险披露要求。

义项: 形容词 适于耕作的土地（arable land 耕地）
[辨析] 只形容土地，不形容作物；与 fertile（肥沃的）不完全等同

例句.英文: Tanada were built by carving the steep hillsides into a series of large, flat steps, thus increasing arable land.
例句.中文: 田代（tanada）是把陡峭山坡凿成一级级宽大平坦的台阶修成的，从而扩大了耕地面积。

例句.英文: This agricultural method allowed farmers to increase arable land and prevent landslides.
例句.中文: 这种耕作方式使农民得以扩大可耕地并防止山体滑坡。

义项: 动词 强调、使格外明显（further underscores its role）
动词 在文字下划线；比喻义在学术写作中极常用

例句.英文: This increased genetic variety among related light-emitting species further underscores bioluminescence’s crucial role in marine biodiversity and evolution.
例句.中文: 相关发光物种之间遗传多样性的增加，进一步凸显了生物发光在海洋生物多样性与演化中的关键作用。

义项: 动词 慢慢享受某种感受或经历（savor good news 品味好消息）
[辨析] 强调延长时间去体会；与 enjoy 相比更带「不舍得一口吞下」的意味

例句.英文: On average, those who kept good news secret reported feeling more energized by the experience than participants who shared did, perhaps, as the researchers suggest, because the choice to savor good news is usually a personal one and autonomous motivation is linked with feelings of vitality.
例句.中文: 平均而言，把好消息保密的人报告说，这一经历让他们更有活力，胜过把消息分享出去的人；研究者认为，这也许是因为「细细品味好消息」通常是个人自主的选择，而自主性动机与活力感相关联。

义项: 形容词 障碍大到无法逾越（insurmountable reluctance 难以克服的抗拒）
[构词] in- 否定 + surmount 攀登、克服 + -able
搭配说明: 复盘 — 与 657 reserve 共用同一 Ethan Frome 真题句——an insurmountable reluctance to speak of him，背 insurmountable 时顺带复盘 reserve 的「沉默」义

例句.英文: There was no hint of disapproval in her reserve; I merely felt in her an insurmountable reluctance to speak of him.
例句.中文: 她的沉默中并没有一丝不赞成的意味；我只是感到，她内心有一种难以克服的抗拒，不愿谈起他。

义项: 名词 以对等回报为基础的社会规范（reciprocity nudge 互惠式助推）
[构词] reciprocal 相互的 → reciprocity；行为经济学常用

例句.英文: The team also found that the specific type of nudge (reciprocity, compensation, etc.) did not significantly affect user behavior.
例句.中文: 团队还发现，助推的具体类型（互惠、补偿等）并未显著影响用户行为。

义项: 名词 不通过货币的直接交换（barter economy 物物交换经济）
[辨析] 与 commodity currency（商品货币）相对：后者已有共同等价物

例句.英文: By using specific goods like cotton as common units of exchange, commodity currency economies streamline trade, which is why they often replaced barter economies.
例句.中文: 通过以棉花等特定商品作为共同交换单位，商品货币经济简化了贸易，这也是它们往往取代物物交换经济的原因。

例句.英文: Economists Bruce Champ and Scott Freeman: bartering requires that “the person with whom you wish to trade must not only have what you want but also want what you have.
例句.中文: 经济学家 Bruce Champ 与 Scott Freeman 指出：以物易物要求「你想与之交易的人，不仅要拥有你想要的东西，还必须想要你拥有的东西」。
